descriptor: Developer documentation for the Forge API

voice.summary: Writes like a good reference manual with a friendly colleague's sense of what you will trip on. Imperative steps, real code and warnings placed right before the mistake.
dos: Use imperative verbs for every step
Put the code sample straight after the sentence that needs it
State what a failure looks like
donts: No marketing language in a reference page
Avoid vague phrases like simply or just
Do not repeat what the code already says

taglines: Build it right the first time
Docs for people who read code
boilerplate: forge/docs is the documentation home for the Forge API, with guides, an API reference and copy-ready code for developers building on a secret-key model.

logo.note: The name is written like a path, so a plain lowercase wordmark with an F monogram fits the developer audience.
